task_message:
Case M11: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 440x440x210 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary:** I segmented the large, T2-hyperintense lobulated myxoid soft-tissue tumor in the right anterior thigh/groin of case M11. A single positive point in the tumor core (axial slice 105) produced an accurate 3D mask (81.4 mL, one component) spanning the full cranio-caudal extent (axial ~74–143). I verified the boundary in axial, coronal, and sagittal planes including the superior/inferior ends and all past-the-mask review panels, and rejected two small intensity-based candidate proposals (C1/C2) after zoomed inspection showed they were thin, vessel-like strands extending beyond the lesion rather than contiguous tumor. Final mask saved with medium confidence.
